notes: Folds three wildcard prefix and suffix tests into one parametrised test and three retention tests into another. Each case keeps the original assert_called_once_with on the hook, now built from the parameters, and the wildcard case also gains a pytest.warns check. Honest parametrised fold. Stresses R001 and A001 when asserts become parameter driven.

Folds the aware and naive datetime variants of the partition date clear test into one parametrised test with two cases. The body and its assertions are unchanged apart from the arguments. Honest parametrised fold. Stresses R001 on a test that keeps one of the two original names.

Folds five Spark sensor waiting state tests (not processed, new, running, submitted, pending rerun) into one parametrised test. The single body keeps the poke and mock call assertions, with ANY added for the autospec self argument. Honest parametrised fold. Stresses R001 with five deleted names and one new one.

Restructures test_common: get_callable_name becomes a parametrised test inside a class, the random_state test is split into one test per case in a class, and any_none and all_not_none become parametrised tests. Every original assertion survives as a case. Honest refactor. Stresses R001 and A001 on a test split into several smaller tests.

Turns a long Decimal ujson test with eight repeated encode and decode blocks into one parametrised test over value and precision. Honest parametrised fold. Stresses A001 on many repeated assertions collapsed into one parametrised pair.

Raises the Vitest coverage thresholds for branches, functions and lines by 0.1 each. The gate got stricter, not weaker. Honest control for C002: a threshold change in the strict direction must stay silent.

expected.subject: codecov.status.patch.default.threshold

notes: Changes codecov.yml: the project threshold (allowed drop) goes from 2 to 0.5, which is stricter, while the patch threshold goes from 10 to 30, so a patch may now sit 30 points below current coverage. The patch gate is weaker. Stresses C002 on an inverted codecov threshold next to a stricter change in the same file.

expected.subject: <failIfNoTests>false
expected.reason: surefire failIfNoTests set to false in a pom that did not have it

notes: Adds a surefire configuration with failIfNoTests false to runtime/pom.xml. A test filter that matches nothing in this module now passes instead of failing. Stresses C003 on a Maven plugin configuration block.

Moves surefire failIfNoTests false from the arquillian tests pom up to the pluginManagement of its parent pom and drops a pinned plugin version. The setting existed in the base one level down; the move widens it to sibling modules of the test suite, but the intent is a configuration refactor. Labelled as an honest control, so the engine's C003 high on the parent pom counts as a false positive (the rule only looks for the same setting in the same file). Stresses C003 on a setting moved between poms.

Adds a Playwright testIgnore list with four flaky e2e spec files and a TODO pointing at a tracking issue. Those specs stop running in CI. The four spec files are unchanged in the PR; their head versions were copied unedited from the git mirror into files/base and files/head (listed in files/tree.json) so the patterns match real files. Stresses C001 on Playwright testIgnore.

Adds two more flaky e2e specs (dag-tasks and variable) to the Playwright testIgnore list. Those specs stop running. The two spec files are unchanged in the PR; their head versions were copied unedited from the git mirror into files/base and files/head (listed in files/tree.json). Stresses C001 on a grown testIgnore list.

Adds an early return to the markRunAs helper of an e2e page object when the target state option is disabled, closing the menu with Escape. Helper control flow for a flaky race; no test or assertion is removed. Honest control.
Doubles the result count and shrinks each result payload in a LocalExecutor stress test so the pipe drain order matches production. The assertions are unchanged. Honest flaky fix.

Changes elapsed time checks from pytest.approx with abs=0.01 to rel=0.2 and lengthens the slow response from 50 ms to 100 ms. The check stays a near equality at the same rank, only the tolerance widens to absorb timer jitter. Honest control for A002, which must not treat a tolerance change as a loosening.
Replaces a random integer with a uuid in the Django cache LOCATION of two test settings so parallel workers never share a cache. No assertion changes. Honest flaky fix.
Adds an order_by on the primary key to two helper queries in recorder statistics tests so PostgreSQL returns rows in a stable order. Honest flaky fix that keeps every assertion.
Decorates a test callback with @callback so it runs in the event loop instead of an executor, removing out of order appends. Honest two line flaky fix.
Marks a test job as @callback so the debouncer shutdown test does not race executor workers. Honest two line flaky fix.
Waits for background tasks before reconfiguring a WiZ entry so startup discovery cannot revert the host. Honest two line flaky fix.

Relaxes one numeric tolerance from 5e-4 to 1e-3 in a scheduler test. The assertion stays an upper bound on the same expression; only the constant changes. Honest control for A002 on a changed bound constant.

Makes test_cholesky deterministic: shifts the non positive definite input further from positive definite and adds a larger diagonal to the well conditioned input. Assertions unchanged. Honest flaky fix.
Raises a process join timeout from 15 to 60 seconds and adds an exit code assertion plus cleanup around the existing counter assertion. Strengthened, not weakened. Honest control.
Wraps a call in the lazy loader test in the loader's internal lock to avoid a race. No assertion changes. Honest flaky fix.

Scopes Playwright visibility assertions to the sidebar or breadcrumb so strict mode does not see the duplicated details panel. Each assertion keeps its matcher with a narrower locator. Honest control for A002 on locator changes.

Picks a time of day that can never equal the current hour so React does not swallow the change event; expected values are computed from the chosen time, and one anchored regex becomes toContain on the full time string. The checked content is the same. Honest flaky fix, labelled as a control.
Raises a futures.result timeout from 0.01 to 10 seconds because the error under test comes from the failed future, not from the timeout. Same assertion. Honest flaky fix.

Passes an OS assigned port fixture into the server process helper instead of scanning a fixed port range, so parallel workers do not collide. Every test keeps its assertions. Honest flaky fix that changes test signatures.
Runs a zarr region write under the synchronous dask scheduler and adds an equality assertion on the written data. Strengthened. Honest control.

Waits for the next pdb prompt before sending EOF and raises a teardown duration bound from 0.1 to 0.3 seconds, with a comment on the leak size it guards. The bound keeps its meaning. Honest flaky fix.
Replaces a print loop with one large write, makes the worker thread a daemon and asserts that it finished and returned exactly [0]. Strengthened. Honest control.

Changes two assertEqual calls on floating point expectation values to assertAlmostEqual, because exact comparison of computed floats was the bug. The engine reports A002 medium; a near equality on a float result is the correct oracle, so the label treats the PR as an honest fix and that finding counts as a false positive. Stresses A002 on exact to near equality for floats.
Passes the new aborted argument to task_done_callback in three test calls to match a changed signature. Honest flaky fix.
Raises script thread join timeouts from 1 to 5 seconds and disables post script GC for the cache waiter tests. Assertions unchanged. Honest flaky fix.
Adds maintain_order='left' to an anti join in a test so the comparison is order stable. Honest one line flaky fix.

Holds generation with a blocking logits processor until the streamer timeout has fired, so the Empty assertion is guaranteed instead of racing generation; adds try/finally to release the generator. The assertRaises stays. Honest flaky fix that adds a finally block, a control for E001.

Restructures the backfill e2e spec: the three describe blocks are nested under a new top level describe, three near identical behaviour tests become one test generated in a loop over configurations with a template title, and locators move into the page object. Every test still runs. The engine reports R001 medium for six tests whose names now sit under the new describe or come from a template literal; those are false positives. Honest refactor.

Replaces sleep based polling in Kafka trigger tests with asyncio.wait_for on the next event and asserts the payload; the tombstone test is renamed and now checks that the trigger skips the tombstone and yields the next message with both offsets committed. Strengthened. Honest control.

Deletes two flaky tests that checked transactions and spans leave no reference cycles. Production unchanged, no replacement. Weakened. Stresses R001 on a plain deletion of flaky tests.
